audited: server/constants/roles.js, server/utils/modeRole.js, capability/grant checks, requireAuth/requireRole usage
feature flags: client/src/utils/launchScope.js, server/middleware/launchGate.js, requireLogisticsPayments.js, feature_flags table
excluded: internal operations (/internal/*, /logistics/operations/*, compliance-workspace, admin-control, delivery operations)

workflows.title: Create an account
workflows.permissions: Guest (no auth). Self-selectable modes: customer, helper, business_owner.
workflows.notes: Email OTP verification is part of the flow; /verify-email handles verification links. Mode-specific onboarding follows (see account-onboarding).

workflows.title: Sign in
workflows.notes: Supports password, TOTP 2FA step-up, and passkey login. Sessions managed at /settings/sessions.

workflows.title: Recover a forgotten password
workflows.notes: Standard email-token reset flow; no admin involvement needed.

workflows.title: Switch between customer, helper, business and other modes
clientRoutes: Mode switcher (in-app navigation; no dedicated route)
workflows.permissions: Authenticated. Self-selectable: customer, helper, business_owner. Granted (membership required): business_manager, business_representative, business_employee, business_support_agent. Admin mode reserved for admin roles.
workflows.notes: Modes map to RBAC roles (e.g. restaurant_owner -> helper class). Granted modes require proof of underlying membership; they do not auto-activate.

workflows.title: Verify identity (Didit)
workflows.notes: Didit phase two: verification anchored to the universal public entity ID, 2-year TTL, fail-closed; Didit-verified users auto-pass the credit rail identity review. DIDIT_ALLOW_USER_SKIP is default-open per standing decision. The background-check request UI in HelperDashboard is additionally gated by the backgroundChecks launch flag (default false).

workflows.title: Complete helper or business onboarding
workflows.permissions: Authenticated. Listing, bidding and starting work enforce onboarding server-side.
workflows.notes: Helpers onboard via the helper-registration API (tiers helper/helper_pro/broker, W-9); businesses via BusinessOnboardingPage and the launch-request flow.

workflows.title: Manage account settings
featureFlags: LAUNCH_SETTINGS_TABS (profile, security, businesses, notifications, privacy, account, danger, tax)
workflows.notes: Includes 2FA, passkeys, sessions, notification and country settings. The tax (W-9) tab is helper-only and satisfies the tax-identity gate on payouts.

workflows.title: Privacy controls, data export, account deletion
workflows.permissions: Guest for public policy pages; authenticated for export/deletion.
workflows.notes: Public legal pages plus authenticated data-subject actions (verified export, deletion request).

workflows.title: Get help and track support tickets
serverHandlers: POST /api/support/public/conversations (+ verify, resend-code, messages, review, reopen, download)
workflows.permissions: Guest for public conversations (code-verified); authenticated for tickets.
workflows.notes: Excludes /support/agent and /support/agent/workspace, which are support-agent tooling and out of scope for this matrix.

workflows.title: Find helpers and services
workflows.permissions: Guest can browse the directory; sign-in required to book.
featureFlags: discoverEverything: false (full 'everything' scope not launched; Discover page exists)
workflows.notes: Public helper directory plus the OxSteed-operated Direct catalog. Helper profiles at /helpers/:id are public.

workflows.title: Post a job
workflows.notes: Draft autosave supported via the draft endpoints; the public job page /jobs/public/:jobId is read-only.

workflows.title: Manage posted jobs
workflows.notes: Covers edit, cancel, complete, assign, and appointment scheduling on owned jobs.

workflows.title: Compare bids on a job
workflows.notes: Customers compare per-job bids and accept/decline; helpers track their own bids in the same views.

workflows.title: Book a helper, business, or service slot
workflows.permissions: Authenticated; requireEmailVerified and requireTermsAcceptance on booking creation.
workflows.notes: Supports counter-proposals, recurring bookings (pause/resume/cancel), and converting a booking into a job.

workflows.title: Message about a job or booking
workflows.notes: Job-scoped conversations plus guest inquiries so customers can ask pre-booking questions.

workflows.title: See payment and order records
workflows.permissions: Authenticated; food tracking token is guest-accessible.
workflows.notes: Bookings, product orders, and food orders each have their own history views.

workflows.title: Mark a job complete
workflows.notes: Completion opens review eligibility; work-agreement completion is a separate step from job completion.

workflows.title: Leave and respond to reviews
clientRoutes: (in job detail and order views; no dedicated route)
workflows.notes: Bilateral reviews (review plus response); food order reviews are a separate per-order flow.

workflows.title: Cancel a booking or job
workflows.notes: Helper cancellation policies are configurable at /settings/payment-policies; food-order cancellation is POST /api/orders/:orderId/cancel (see restaurant-cancellations).

workflows.title: Open and manage a dispute
workflows.notes: User-facing dispute flow with evidence and messaging. Admin review/resolve endpoints are platform-admin tooling (excluded); the arbitration policy page at /legal/arbitration is public.

workflows.title: Create and sign work agreements
workflows.notes: Records-room model: drawn signatures required from both parties, version timeline, change orders, warranty claims.

workflows.title: Request a quote (Direct)
workflows.permissions: Guest can request and look up by code; authenticated for detail.
workflows.notes: Distinct from helper quotes (helper-quotes) and business quotes (business-quotes).

workflows.title: Manage helper profile and public listing
workflows.permissions: Authenticated for edits; public profile is guest-visible.
workflows.notes: Vanity slug support via profileSlugs; services and FAQs managed on the profile.

workflows.title: Manage skills
workflows.notes: Skill categories with lookup; /profile/tool-rentals redirects to the skills tab.

workflows.title: Set availability
workflows.notes: General availability on the helper profile plus a dedicated consultant availability page (consultant is a helper-class mode).

workflows.title: Browse open jobs
workflows.permissions: Guest can browse; authenticated for saved searches; sign-in plus completed onboarding to bid.
workflows.notes: The job list is public; bidding is gated on auth and onboarding.

workflows.title: Bid on a job
workflows.notes: Bid withdrawal and reconfirmation supported.

workflows.title: Send quotes to customers
workflows.notes: Helper-issued quotes, distinct from business quotes and Direct quote requests.

workflows.title: Work assigned jobs and incoming bookings
workflows.notes: Helpers accept or decline incoming booking requests and work assigned jobs.

workflows.title: Create and send invoices
workflows.permissions: Authenticated helper; public token link is guest-viewable.
workflows.notes: Public invoice link via token; separate from business invoices (/api/invoices).

workflows.title: Receive payouts
workflows.permissions: Authenticated helper; tax-identity (W-9) gate on withdrawals.
workflows.notes: Payouts require tax identity; the dashboard earnings overview section is separately gated (see helper-earnings).

workflows.title: View earnings overview
workflows.condition: Visible only when the helperEarnings launch flag is enabled (default off). The /helper/payouts page and helper-earnings statements remain available while the dashboard section is hidden.
serverHandlers: earnings via payout and statement APIs
workflows.notes: The flag only hides the dashboard earnings section; payouts and statements are not flag-gated.

workflows.title: Manage client relationships
workflows.notes: Client management is conversation- and quote-history based; there is no separate helper CRM record store.

workflows.title: Set up a business (launch request, onboarding, franchise)
workflows.permissions: Launch submit is public (rate-limited); status views authenticated.
workflows.notes: Launch requests go through a request/approval flow, not instant provisioning; franchise is a separate intake track.

workflows.title: Select and switch between businesses
workflows.notes: Users with several businesses switch via the managed list; team invitations are accepted here.

workflows.title: Manage team members and roles
workflows.permissions: Authenticated; bizIdAccess capability checks per business.
workflows.notes: Team member modes (business_manager, business_representative, business_employee) are granted, not self-selected, and entered via the mode switcher.

workflows.title: Manage business services
workflows.notes: Core services CRUD is live; specialized intake request pages are separately gated (see business-specialized-intakes).

workflows.title: Submit specialized intake requests (maintenance, trades, beauty, creative, professional, continuity)
workflows.condition: Requires the specializedProfileTemplates launch flag (default false). While disabled the server launchGate returns 404 for the public intake API and the client hides the flow; the hub intake tabs are pre-defined in LAUNCH_BUSINESS_HUB_TABS for launch.
workflows.permissions: Guest can open the pages; submission blocked while gated.
workflows.notes: Intake triage tabs (beauty-ops, creative-ops, continuity-ops, professional-ops, trades-ops, maintenance) exist in the hub tab registry for when the flag launches.

workflows.title: Manage business clients
workflows.notes: Full client record CRUD scoped to the business.

workflows.title: Schedule appointments and manage staff schedules
workflows.notes: Shared calendar across modes; iCal export per appointment; staff scheduling and time entries for teams.

workflows.title: Post and manage jobs as a business
workflows.notes: Businesses reuse the standard job workflows (post, assign, cancel, complete).

workflows.title: Invoice clients as a business
workflows.notes: Per-invoice OxSteed Credit and card payment eligibility checks (businessInvoiceCreditPayService).

workflows.title: Work the attention inbox
workflows.notes: Aggregates tasks needing owner attention (intakes, approvals, alerts) into the hub overview.

workflows.title: Work the lead pipeline
clientRoutes: (no route; BusinessLeadsPage.jsx is not routed in App.jsx)
workflows.notes: UNAVAILABLE: the client page exists but is never imported or routed in client/src/App.jsx, so there is no reachable UI. Server lead-pipeline APIs exist but have no user surface.

workflows.title: Set up a restaurant (merchant onboarding)
workflows.notes: Setup progress tracking plus the restaurant-credit approval funding path with proof submission.

workflows.title: Manage menus and items
workflows.notes: Full menu-item CRUD with duplication and modifier groups.

workflows.title: Configure store settings
workflows.notes: Store panels cover ops, reports, audit, and training; device pairing for displays and POS.

workflows.title: Order food as a customer
workflows.permissions: Guest can browse and quote; authenticated to order; checkRestrictions('checkout') on payment.
workflows.notes: Quote-to-checkout flow with restaurant-credit wallet payment sessions. Separate from the product-marketplace cart checkout, which is launch-gated (productMarketplace: false).

workflows.title: Prepare orders (kitchen)
workflows.permissions: Kitchen page behind auth; queue board is public.
workflows.notes: Kitchen display feed with device API for KDS-style screens; order splitting supported.

workflows.title: Hand off pickup and delivery orders
workflows.permissions: Guest via tracking token; runner actions authenticated.
workflows.notes: Public order tracking plus runner handoff through local delivery jobs with proof-of-delivery.

workflows.title: Cancel a food order
workflows.notes: Both customer-initiated cancellation and merchant status-driven cancellation.

workflows.title: Request refunds on restaurant credit and orders
workflows.notes: Food-order refunds re-credit credit transactionally; direct/pay-at-restaurant orders are marked refunded with no automatic money movement. Support cases are the escalation path.

workflows.title: Use POS, inventory, crew, and runner tools
workflows.notes: Device-oriented staff tooling (POS, inventory, crew, runner) with heartbeat and issue reporting.

workflows.title: View the wallet overview
workflows.notes: /wallet is the overview; full credit detail lives at /oxsteed-credit.

workflows.title: Use OxSteed Credit (top-ups, transfers, withdrawals, cards)
workflows.condition: Requires the oxsteed_credit_enabled feature flag (feature_flags table). It is ON in production as of 2026-10-11. When the rail is off, food-wallet writes fail open with backfill markers replayed by a sweeper on re-enable, while fiat paths (top-ups, withdrawals, conversions, cards, compliance) fail closed.
workflows.permissions: Authenticated; checkRestrictions('checkout') and rate limiters on money movement.
workflows.notes: Distinct from Restaurant Credit (restaurant-scoped wallets). Identity verification via Didit auto-passes the credit rail review.

workflows.title: Use Restaurant Credit (per-restaurant wallets)
workflows.notes: Distinct from OxSteed Credit: wallets are scoped per restaurant. Customer top-ups $5-$500 with a $1,000/day/user/restaurant cap and step-up auth at $250.

workflows.title: Get paid by QR / pay by QR
workflows.permissions: Authenticated for setup; guest can pay at /pay/:code.
featureFlags: genericQrGenerator: false (no code enforcement found on /qr-generator; page is reachable)
workflows.notes: Helpers and businesses create reusable pay codes; payers need no account (Stripe Checkout).

workflows.title: View receipts
workflows.notes: Receipts are rendered in context (Direct payment receipt, food order detail); there is no standalone receipts hub.

workflows.title: View statements
workflows.notes: Per-product statement archives (restaurant, oxsteed, helper_earnings, business, restaurant_settlement) with an accessible view.

workflows.title: Browse archived statements
workflows.notes: Archive is per product; documents support download and share links.

workflows.title: Download statement exports
workflows.notes: Bulk and accounting exports plus CSV/PDF statement downloads; export jobs tracked by ID.

workflows.title: Browse logistics campaigns and lanes
workflows.permissions: Guest can browse; sign-in required to participate.
workflows.notes: Campaign browsing is public; participation, sourcing, and finance require auth.

workflows.title: Pledge to a campaign (buyer)
workflows.notes: Pledging is joining a campaign; allocations track the buyer's share with release support.

workflows.title: Organize a campaign
workflows.notes: Draft submission/approval state machine with guarded transitions and approval history; recurring programs supported.

workflows.title: Create sourcing requests and collect supplier quotes
workflows.notes: Supplier quotes attach to requests; quote acceptance is the gated payments flow (see logistics-accept-quotes).

workflows.title: Publish and accept quotes
workflows.condition: Requires LOGISTICS_PAYMENTS_ENABLED=true (default off). While disabled the quote lifecycle routes answer 503.
workflows.notes: Versioned quotes; dual-admin refund approval is platform-admin tooling (excluded).

workflows.title: Confirm payments at checkout
workflows.condition: Requires LOGISTICS_PAYMENTS_ENABLED=true (default off). While disabled every route below answers 503 and the client checkout shows a disabled state.
workflows.notes: Stripe plus OxSteed Credit checkout with signed-webhook-only settlement and reconciliation.

workflows.title: Track shipments
workflows.notes: Milestone and document tracking per shipment.

workflows.title: Manage distribution and deliveries
workflows.notes: Distributor/reseller dashboard plus delivery status management.

workflows.title: File and track claims
workflows.notes: Claims are filed via API and surfaced in the buyer dashboard; there is no standalone claims page.

workflows.title: Request logistics refunds
workflows.notes: User-scoped refund cases linked to claims; dual-admin approval is platform-admin tooling (excluded).

workflows.title: Manage warehousing and inventory receipts
workflows.notes: Inventory receipts with receive/reconcile; operator warehouse-ops dashboards are internal (excluded).

workflows.title: Check trade compliance and restrictions
workflows.notes: Buyer-facing restrictions and trade rules; the compliance review workspace is operator-gated (excluded).

workflows.title: Use OxSteed Media (feed, posts, communities)
workflows.permissions: Guest for feed; authenticated for compose, bookmarks, notifications, messages.
workflows.notes: Media is launched; compose, notifications, and messages require sign-in.

workflows.title: Use Direct (OxSteed-operated services)
workflows.permissions: Guest for landing, catalog, and lookup; authenticated for booking, history, account.
workflows.notes: Direct is OxSteed-operated services, distinct from the helper marketplace. Excludes /direct/admin/* (platform admin tooling).

workflows.title: Request and track deliveries
workflows.permissions: Guest for landing and quoting; authenticated for jobs; drivers claim jobs.
workflows.notes: Excludes /delivery/operations/*, which is logistics-operator-gated internal dispatch.

workflows.title: Manage the calendar
workflows.notes: Shared calendar across modes with confirm/cancel/reschedule and iCal export.

workflows.title: Message across the platform
workflows.notes: Mode-specific inboxes (customer and helper); job-context messaging is covered under hiring-message.

workflows.title: Request and deliver consulting
workflows.permissions: Guest for intake; authenticated for portal and contractor dashboard.
workflows.notes: Consultant is a helper-class mode with its own availability and contractor dashboard.

workflows.title: Rent and list tools
workflows.permissions: Guest can browse; authenticated to list or rent.
workflows.notes: tool_owner is a helper-class mode; owners get an analytics dashboard.

workflows.title: Plan recurring needs
workflows.notes: Recurring household-need planning with templates, suggestions, and preferred-helper offers.

workflows.title: Manage vehicle records (car care garage)
workflows.notes: A vehicle garage for owned-vehicle records (makes/models), not a service-booking flow.
